items.text: Houston FINAL: OUT - RB David Montgomery (groin), S Reed Blankenship (concussion/hand). LB Azeez Al-Shaair, OTs Blake Fisher and Braden Smith, TE Brevin Jordan, S Jalen Pitre no designation. C.J. Stroud starts.

Los Angeles Chargers FINAL: OUT - CB Deane Leonard (concussion), S Kendall Williamson (calf). DOUBTFUL - TE David Njoku (fibula), LB Denzel Perryman (pectoral), WR Brenen Thompson (quad/hamstring), G Kayode Awosika (fibula). Khalil Mack, Donte Jackson, Rodney Shelley cleared. On IR: S Derwin James Jr., OT Rashawn Slater, C Tyler Biadasz. Justin Herbert starts.
